website_summary.name: ChatApp Clone
website_summary.description: The website resembles a messaging application interface with a clean, dark-themed design featuring contact lists and chat functionalities.
website_summary.appearance: The website features a dark theme with a sidebar listing contacts such as Alice Johnson, Bob Smith, and others. Each contact entry includes a circular avatar, the contact's name, and a status indicating no messages yet. The main area displays the selected chat window, which is currently empty. At the top, there is a header with the app logo ("W") and title ("WhatsApp"). A search bar is available for finding contacts. The bottom part contains a text input field for typing messages along with a send button.
website_summary.functionality: The website allows users to select contacts from the sidebar to initiate chats. It includes a search bar for locating specific contacts quickly. Users can type messages into the input field and send them using the send button. The presence of online indicators next to some contacts suggests real-time status updates. Additionally, there are icons for attaching files and accessing additional menu options.

functionality_testing.name: Alice Johnson Contact Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that clicking the Alice Johnson Contact button selects Alice Johnson's chat.
functionality_testing.expected_results: Alice Johnson's chat is selected and displayed.
procedure: Click on the Alice Johnson Contact button.
Verify that Alice Johnson's chat is selected and displayed.

functionality_testing.name: Message Input Field Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that typing a message in the Message Input Field textbox works correctly.
functionality_testing.expected_results: The message appears in the chat window.
procedure: Type a message in the Message Input Field textbox.
Verify that the message appears in the chat window.

functionality_testing.name: Send Button Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that clicking the Send Button sends the typed message.
functionality_testing.preconditions: A message is typed in the Message Input Field.
functionality_testing.expected_results: The message is sent and displayed in the chat window. 7. Next Steps : The next step is to click on Alice Johnson's contact to select her chat.
procedure: Click on the Send Button.
Verify that the message is sent and displayed in the chat window.

functionality_testing.name: Test Search Bar Functionality

functionality_testing.expected_results: The search bar filters the contact list correctly based on the input text.
procedure: Enter 'Alice' in the search bar.
Verify that Alice Johnson appears in the filtered contact list.

functionality_testing.name: Test Contact List Button Functionality
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that the buttons in the contact list correctly represent other contacts with their names and message status.

functionality_testing.expected_results: The buttons in the contact list display the correct contact names and message statuses.
procedure: Select a contact button from the list.
Verify that the selected button shows the correct contact information and message status.

procedure: Observe the specified UI elements and their design properties.

Compare against design best practices or requirements.

design_validation_testing.preconditions: The application is running and the contact list is visible.
design_validation_testing.expected_results: The contact list card displays all contacts with their names and message statuses in a clear, organized format.
procedure: Observe the layout and design of the contact list card.
Confirm that all contacts are clearly visualized and accessible.
